video_title: Is Taiwan Semiconductor Stock an Undervalued AI Stock to Buy Right Now? | TSM STock Analysis

claims.speaker: host
claims.evidence_text: As a result, Taiwan Semiconductor is ramping up investments, adding an additional $100 billion investment in Arizona to construct several more manufacturing facilities to meet this growing demand.
claims.reasoning_summary: TSMC is adding an additional 100 billion USD investment in Arizona for several more fabs to meet growing AI demand.

claims.speaker: host
claims.evidence_text: So, the proliferation of AI demand is creating an additional leg of growth for Taiwan Semiconductor. $143 billion in trailing 12-month revenue.
claims.reasoning_summary: TSMC has 143 billion USD in trailing 12-month revenue, with growth accelerating since ChatGPT.

claims.speaker: host
catalysts: Agentic AI demand for CPUs, memory and storage on top of accelerator demand
claims.evidence_text: And now you're likely to see a further ramp in the slope of that curve as a result of Agentic AI gaining momentum.
claims.reasoning_summary: Revenue growth should accelerate further as agentic AI adds demand for CPUs, memory and storage on top of accelerators; TSMC is already sold out with demand exceeding supply.

claims.speaker: host
claims.evidence_text: 55.84% was the most recent figure on a trailing 12-month basis.
claims.reasoning_summary: Operating margin hit a decade-high record of 55.84% (trailing 12 months) on high capacity utilization and premium pricing.

claims.speaker: host
claims.evidence_text: So the management team is forecasting lower profit margins ahead. But they've been saying this for over a year now and we haven't yet seen that lower margin because their capacity utilization has been so elevated that it's been offsetting those expected decreases in profit margins.
claims.reasoning_summary: Management forecasts lower margins because Arizona production costs much more than Taiwan; the speaker notes they have said this for over a year without it happening yet.

claims.speaker: host
claims.evidence_text: Its customers like Nvidia, Apple, and AMD are concerned that most of its manufacturing availability is in Taiwan and the region is under threat from China.
claims.reasoning_summary: Geopolitical risk: most capacity is in Taiwan, a region under threat from China, which is why customers push TSMC to diversify into the US (also tariffs).

claims.speaker: host
claims.evidence_text: I would say they've been good to very good and certainly above their weighted average cost of capital in almost every moment in the previous decade.
claims.reasoning_summary: Capital allocation has been good to very good, with returns above the cost of capital for a decade (and three decades), so heavy capex is reassuring.

claims.speaker: host

claims.reasoning_summary: TSM stock is up over 48% year to date in 2026.

claims.speaker: host
claims.evidence_text: I've been ranking and rating TSM stock as a great buying opportunity all year.
claims.reasoning_summary: He has rated TSM a great buying opportunity all year.

claims.speaker: host

claims.reasoning_summary: The forward P/E is near its highest in a couple of years, but the absolute valuation is not expensive and trades at a discount to the average S&P 500 stock.

claims.speaker: host
claims.evidence_text: So that risk premium, that geopolitical risk is already incorporated into TSM's valuation.
claims.reasoning_summary: As a US company TSM would trade above 30x forward earnings; the geopolitical risk premium is already priced in.

claims.speaker: host

claims.speaker: host
